string body as is
HTML body: br/p/div/tr -> newline, strip tags, decode entities
else text / textPlain / bodyPreview

div.style: color: rgb(26, 54, 93) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Parse header blocks from the marker down
join indented continuation lines
From: starts a block, To: adds addresses, Sent:/Date: sets date
keep a block only if it has a To, or a From and a date

div.style: color: rgb(26, 54, 93) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Innermost block = last block that has a From line
this is the original sender, not a forwarding hop

div.style: color: rgb(116, 66, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(26, 54, 93) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Use its To addresses
toSource = innermost

div.style: color: rgb(26, 54, 93) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Walk outward one block at a time
to the nearest block with a To line
toSource = outer_block_N
